resources.string: Sabbaq reads the offers shown in supported ride apps only and taps accept on the offer that matches your conditions, after you turn it on. It does nothing without a valid subscription, and you can stop it from the app or the notification at any time.
You set your conditions once, and Sabbaq watches the offers and accepts the ones that match.
Works with the ride apps you already use
Sabbaq follows the offers inside these apps and accepts whatever matches your conditions.
It auto-accepts the offers that match your conditions in the supported apps.
Never settle for less than your terms
Set the lowest fare and the lowest return per km that suit you.
Choose a limit for the distance to the passenger and the trip length.
Set your working hours, and turn accepting on or off whenever you want.
A moment while we show the available options.
Discover it first, then decide if it suits you.
Three moments in every offer, and you decide the outcome in advance.
Example: a fare of 45 SAR for a 15 km trip.
Tap any detail to show it in the example or hide it.
Numbers for illustration only, not a real offer.
